title: Quenched Snappy Ethiopian Buckwheat Bowl
description: A crispy buckwheat dish inspired by the flavors of Ethiopia, featuring a snappy texture and a rich, umami taste. Perfect for a weekend brunch or a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until crispy, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the berbere spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the bamboo shoots and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, the water, and the salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the buckwheat groats, butter or ghee, and salt. Cook until the buckwheat is toasted and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the parsley and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
If using, stir in the fermented chili paste for an added kick.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
